o.norm: Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.
Tests data gathered from around the internets.

i.norm: Full (non-strict) NYSIIS encoder: no 6-character length cap on the output.
Asserts that each input string encodes to its paired expected value under the full NYSIIS encoder. Each element of {@code testValues} is a two-element array: [input, expectedEncoding].

Tests data gathered from around the internets. Verifies phonetically equivalent name variants encode to the same NYSIIS key, and that a simple consonant-cluster transformation ("FUZZY") is handled correctly.
"O'Daniel" and "O'Donnel" are phonetically similar Irish-origin names; both should collapse to the same NYSIIS key "ODANAL".
"Cory", "Corey", and "Kory" are spelling/pronunciation variants of the same name; the leading-K -> C rule and vowel normalisation should all yield "CARY".
"FUZZY" exercises the Z -> S and vowel-normalisation rules, producing "FASY".
